framework: Foundry (forge) within a yarn-managed Balancer V3 monorepo fork
description: QuantAMM is a DeFi protocol launching Blockchain Traded Funds (BTFs): Balancer-V3-based weighted pools whose weights are continuously updated on-chain by quantitative TradFi-style strategies (update rules) driven by oracle price signals, to overcome MEV and impermanent loss.
out_of_scope_contracts: pkg/vault/**, pkg/solidity-utils/**, pkg/pool-utils/** and all other Balancer V3 base contracts (underlying vault/swap/deposit/withdraw infra)
Non-standard ERC20 tokens (rebasing, allowlist, double-entrypoint variants)
Issues already documented in audits/ (certora, spearbit, trail-of-bits) and pkg/pool-quantamm/audit reports (KNOWN ISSUES — out of scope)
Balancer V3 batch-swap routing issues unrelated to QuantAMM integration
severity_rules: CodeHawks standard severity (High/Medium qualify for the 44,640 OP H/M pool; Low for the 4,960 OP pool). Not restated verbatim in README; standard CodeHawks/Cyfrin classification applies.
build_instructions: From repo root: `yarn install`. Then from pkg/pool-quantamm (or pkg/pool-hooks, pkg/interfaces): `forge compile` and `forge test`.
compiler: Solidity (exact pragma read from sources during analysis; Foundry forge build).
docs: audits/ (certora, spearbit, trail-of-bits — prior reports, known issues out of scope)
